name: TradeCore ERP
description: v1.0.9 build 2026-09-08-28 FIXES: (1) EXCLUDED DIRECT_SYNC_KEYS from blob flush — branches/stores/categories were being sent BOTH through direct MySQL AND the state blob, causing 409 Conflict rebase that resurrected deleted items via last-write-wins merge; they now commit ONLY through v2_* atomic endpoints. (2) Increased v2Post timeout from 12s to 30s to handle slow server responses and prevent AbortError on v2_list_companies/v2_list_branches.
